validated_question: Whether the absence of a registered component_resolution + governance_validation executor is a missing implementation that this session should install before the StegFin trade can progress.

findings.repository_resolution_worker_behavior: Recognize an already-authorized node declaration or escalate the unchanged PHYSICAL_RESOURCE constraint to COMPONENT_AUTHORITY; never fabricate a declaration.
findings.resolution_policy: Missing executor at a machine resolution level is itself a constraint collision and escalates to the next level; HUMAN_AUTHORITY is the final explicit boundary if no machine level can legally resolve the condition.

next_executable_action: Resident heartbeat continues G18; if the repository resolver cannot observe an eligible StegVerse-owned/federated node, engine v11 escalates through COMPONENT_AUTHORITY then ECOSYSTEM_GOVERNANCE and ultimately emits an exact HUMAN_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED decision if no admitted machine authority can resolve the physical-resource condition.
stegfin_release_after: G18 terminal nine-predicate carrier proof and heartbeat advance beyond HB29 release STEGFIN-LIVE-ENTRY-003 at release priority.
